parameters.query: SELECT t.id, t.code, t.name, t.sport, (t.organizer_user_id = viewer.id) AS is_owner, (t.fixtures_published_at IS NOT NULL) AS published, (SELECT JSON_ARRAYAGG(JSON_OBJECT('id', d.id, 'name', d.name, 'sort_order', d.sort_order,   'total_matches', (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tournament_matches x WHERE x.division_id = d.id AND x.status <> 'CANCELLED'),   'completed_matches', (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tournament_matches x WHERE x.division_id = d.id AND x.status = 'COMPLETED')))  FROM tournament_divisions d WHERE d.tournament_id = t.id) AS divisions, (SELECT JSON_ARRAYAGG(JSON_OBJECT('division_id', m.division_id, 'status', m.status, 'innings', JSON_EXTRACT(m.live, '$.innings'),   'player_stats', JSON_EXTRACT(m.live, '$.player_stats'), 'potm', JSON_EXTRACT(m.live, '$.potm')))  FROM tournament_matches m WHERE m.tournament_id = t.id AND m.status IN ('LIVE', 'COMPLETED') AND m.live IS NOT NULL) AS matches, (SELECT JSON_ARRAYAGG(JSON_OBJECT('entry_id', e.id, 'name', tm.name, 'short', tm.short_name, 'logo_key', tm.logo_key))  FROM tournament_entries e JOIN teams tm ON tm.id = e.team_id WHERE e.tournament_id = t.id AND e.status = 'APPROVED') AS teams, (SELECT JSON_ARRAYAGG(e.id) FROM tournament_entries e WHERE e.tournament_id = t.id AND e.status = 'APPROVED' AND (  EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM tournament_entry_players ep WHERE ep.entry_id = e.id AND ep.user_id = viewer.id) OR   EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM team_members mm WHERE mm.team_id = e.team_id AND mm.user_id = viewer.id AND mm.status = 'ACTIVE'))) AS my_entries, (SELECT JSON_ARRAYAGG(JSON_OBJECT('m', ev.match_id, 'd', xm.division_id, 's', ev.seq, 'type', ev.type, 'data', ev.data))  FROM match_events ev JOIN tournament_matches xm ON xm.id = ev.match_id  WHERE xm.tournament_id = t.id AND xm.status IN ('LIVE', 'COMPLETED') AND t.sport = 'CRICKET') AS events, (SELECT JSON_ARRAYAGG(JSON_OBJECT('id', ep.team_member_id, 'entry', ep.entry_id, 'name', COALESCE(pu.name, x.guest_name)))  FROM tournament_entry_players ep JOIN team_members x ON x.id = ep.team_member_id LEFT JOIN app_users pu ON pu.id = x.user_id  WHERE ep.tournament_id = t.id AND t.sport = 'CRICKET') AS members FROM tournaments t LEFT JOIN app_users viewer ON viewer.phone = $1 WHERE t.id = (SELECT l.tournament_id FROM tournament_web_links l WHERE l.slug = $2) AND t.status <> 'DRAFT'
